home.title: Littafin rubutun ɗakin aikinku
home.trying: Kuna gwada Glazecalc a matsayin {name}. Fara da girke-girke.
home.welcomeBack: Ci gaba daga inda kuka tsaya.

welcome.heading: Barka da zuwa Glazecalc
welcome.text: Littafin rubutunku ya shirya. Mataki na farko mai kyau: rubuta glaze da kuka saba haɗawa, kayansa da yawansu, ku ga unity formula ɗinsa.
welcome.confirm: Tabbatar da imel ɗinku: mun aika hanyar haɗi zuwa {email}. Shiga mai matakai biyu yana buƙatarsa. <account>Shafin asusunku</account> zai iya sake aika shi.
welcome.confirmText: Mun aika hanyar haɗi zuwa {email}. Buɗe shi don tabbatar da cewa adireshin naku ne: shiga mai matakai biyu yana buƙatarsa. <account>Shafin asusunku</account> zai iya sake aika shi.

recipe.title: Girke-girke
recipe.text: Gina glaze daga kaya da yawansu, ku ga unity formula ɗinsa, ku ajiye shi.

import.title: Liƙa girke-girke
import.text: Liƙa girke-girke daga shafin yanar gizo, takardar lissafi ko bayanai, ku duba abin da aka karanta, ku ajiye su.

blends.title: Haɗe-haɗe don test tile
blends.text: Haɗa girke-girkenku biyu, uku ko huɗu zuwa test tile masu lamba, tare da abin da za a auna wa kowanne.

material.title: Kaya
material.text: Ƙara kayan aiki na kanku, daga formula na sinadarai ko nazarin mai sayarwa.

additive.title: Ƙarin kaya da masu launi
additive.text: Riƙe masu launi da masu hana haske ratsawa da kuke ƙarawa a kan glaze na tushe.

firing.title: Bayanan gasa
firing.text: Rubuta lokuta, zafi da cone na kowace gasa.

notes.title: Bayanai
notes.text: Riƙe sakamakon gwaji da duk wani abin da ya cancanci a tuna.

advice.title: Shawarwarin glaze
advice.text: Shawarwari kan haɗawa, shafa glaze da gasa, da shawarwarinku na kanku.

guides.title: Jagorori
guides.text: Daga mene ne glaze zuwa gasa shi, da kiyaye lafiyar kowa a hanya.

trash.title: Kwandon shara
trash.text: Mayar da abin da kuka cire a cikin kwanaki 30 na ƙarshe.

account.title: Asusu da saituna
account.text: Saituna, kalmar sirrinku, shiga mai matakai biyu, da sauke duk abin da kuke ajiyewa a nan.

home.newHere: Sabo ga unity formula? <advice>Shafin shawarwari</advice> yana bayyana tushen abubuwa, kuma <about>shafin game da mu</about> yana faɗin yadda Glazecalc ke aiki.
